## Context / Problem
While closing ticket 86a5-9221-0037-4e38 on current origin/main, the landed-work precheck scanned all reachable commit messages and printed three unrelated resolver errors such as `Error: Ambiguous prefix 2f3c matches multiple tickets`. The target ticket used a full ID and closed successfully, so these diagnostics came from unrelated historical commit references. `_referencing_commit_exists` calls the shared resolver for every extracted reference; the resolver writes ambiguity errors to stderr even though the precheck only needs to know whether a reference matches the accepted target IDs.

## Approach
Make the close precheck resolve unrelated historical candidates silently while preserving normal resolver diagnostics for user-facing commands. Add a regression test with an ambiguous historical short prefix before a valid full-ID trailer and prove close scanning neither emits the unrelated error nor misses the valid commit.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The close landed-work precheck does not print ambiguity diagnostics for unrelated historical commit references.
- [x] A later valid full-ID commit reference is still detected when earlier history contains an ambiguous short prefix.
- [x] Target-ID ambiguity remains visible in commands where the user explicitly supplies an ambiguous prefix.
- [x] Focused tests and `make lint` pass.
